cards.def:
Severe suffering or difficulty.
हिंदी: कठिनाई / कष्ट

A difficult or unlucky situation.
हिंदी: विपत्ति

The state of being hard to do.
हिंदी: मुश्किल

Something preventing progress.
हिंदी: अवरोध

A reversal in progress.
हिंदी: झटका / असफलता का दौर

Lack of success.
हिंदी: असफलता

Physical or emotional suffering.
हिंदी: पीड़ा / दर्द

The state of undergoing pain.
हिंदी: दुख / कष्ट सहना

The denial, setting aside, or sacrifice of one's own personal interests and desires for others.
हिंदी: आत्म-त्याग
examples: Mother Teresa's life of service was a supreme testament to humble self-abnegation.
Soldiers on the frontier demonstrate profound self-abnegation to guard national borders.
Parents often practice quiet self-abnegation so their children can afford higher education.
Spiritual traditions revere self-abnegation as a path to transcending the ego.

cards.def:
The quality of being resolute, unwavering, firmly loyal, and constant in duty or belief.
हिंदी: अडिगता
examples: His steadfastness in defending democratic values earned him global international respect.
Despite ferocious opposition, the reformist leader maintained unwavering steadfastness.
The lighthouse stood with granite steadfastness against the pounding ocean waves.
True friendship is proven by steadfastness during another's darkest hours of sorrow.

cards.def:
Continuing firmly despite opposition.
हिंदी: लगातार प्रयास

An indomitable, tenacious inner strength that refuses to submit, give up, or surrender to defeat.
हिंदी: अदम्य भावना
examples: The paralyzed athlete triumphed at the Paralympics through sheer unyielding spirit.
History celebrates the unyielding spirit of freedom fighters who defied colonial empires.
An unyielding spirit enables entrepreneurs to rebuild stronger after bankruptcy.
Despite devastating natural disasters, the islanders' unyielding spirit shone brightly.

cards.def:
Courage and resolve.
हिंदी: जुझारूपन / हौसला

A firm, unbreakable determination to achieve an objective regardless of obstacles.
हिंदी: लोहे जैसा संकल्प
examples: The prime minister tackled the economic crisis with iron resolve and decisive leadership.
Quitting a lifelong addiction requires immense personal support and an iron resolve.
Mountaineers need an iron resolve to push through sub-zero blizzard conditions.
Her iron resolve to finish law school while working two jobs yielded top academic honors.

cards.def:
The power to control one's own impulses, emotions, desires, and actions through conscious will.
हिंदी: आत्म-नियंत्रण में महारत
examples: Ancient philosophers taught that self-mastery is the highest and most noble victory.
Elite athletes achieve peak performance through years of disciplined self-mastery.
Self-mastery protects individuals from destructive addictions and impulsive outbursts.
Learning to respond thoughtfully rather than react angrily is a hallmark of self-mastery.

cards.def:
Great courage, boldness, and heroism in the face of immense danger, especially in battle.
हिंदी: शौर्य
examples: The soldier was awarded the highest military decoration for conspicuous valour in combat.
Tales of historical valour inspire generations with stories of selfless patriotism.
Firefighters displayed astonishing personal valour entering the collapsing inferno.
True valour is conquering inner terror to protect innocent lives under threat.

cards.def:
Fearlessness, bold intrepidity, and determination that cannot be intimidated.
हिंदी: निडरता
examples: Her dauntlessness in investigating the criminal cartel exposed corruption at the highest level.
Explorers charted unknown polar waters with awe-inspiring dauntlessness.
Dauntlessness in the courtroom allowed the young prosecutor to challenge mafia bosses.
Facing tyranny with peaceful dauntlessness has toppled oppressive regimes throughout history.

cards.def:
Great courage in danger.
हिंदी: शौर्य / वीरता

Great bravery and sacrifice.
हिंदी: वीरता

The refusal to accept something.
हिंदी: प्रतिरोध

Bold, open resistance and refusal to submit to an unjust authority or insurmountable odds.
हिंदी: अवज्ञा / खुली चुनौती
examples: The lone student stood in heroic defiance against the row of armored tanks.
Striking miners sang anthems of defiance on the picket lines through freezing winter days.
Her fiery speech was a bold act of defiance against the corrupt municipal council.
The community raised their national flag in open defiance of the occupying forces.

cards.def:
A fundamental change in society.
हिंदी: क्रांति

Public campaigning for change.
हिंदी: आंदोलन / उग्र विरोध

A group working for change.
हिंदी: आंदोलन / अभियान

The quality of having an invincible courage and resolve that cannot be subdued or conquered.
हिंदी: अजेय भावना
examples: The heroic resistance fighter's indomitability became a legend passed down through generations.
Facing relentless legal intimidation, the investigative journalist displayed total indomitability.
Physical handicaps could not diminish the indomitability of the record-breaking mountaineer.
Indomitability of spirit allows ordinary citizens to stand tall against authoritarian regimes.

cards.def:
A moral, principled campaign fought against oppression, cruelty, or injustice.
हिंदी: धर्मयुद्ध / न्यायसंगत संघर्ष
examples: Freedom fighters dedicated their entire youth to the righteous struggle for independence.
History validates those who sacrifice personal comfort to lead a righteous struggle.
A righteous struggle against racial segregation mobilized millions of ordinary citizens.
Patience and unwavering moral conviction sustain activists through a long righteous struggle.

cards.def:
A complete change.
हिंदी: रूपांतरण / बदलाव

Gradual development.
हिंदी: विकासक्रम

Effort to achieve fairness.
हिंदी: न्याय के लिए संघर्ष
examples: Struggle for Justice must be peaceful.

cards.def:
Effort to gain liberty.
हिंदी: स्वतंत्रता के लिए संघर्ष
examples: Struggle for Freedom must be remembered.

cards.def:
Effort to achieve equal rights.
हिंदी: समानता के लिए संघर्ष

Effort to stay alive.
हिंदी: अस्तित्व के लिए संघर्ष
examples: Struggle for Survival must be respected.

cards.def:
Effort to be acknowledged.
हिंदी: पहचान/मान्यता के लिए संघर्ष
examples: Struggle for Recognition must be respected.

cards.def:
Effort to define oneself.
हिंदी: अस्मिता के लिए संघर्ष
examples: Struggle for Identity must be respected.

cards.def:
Conflict within oneself.
हिंदी: आंतरिक संघर्ष

Defeating a difficulty.
हिंदी: उबर जाना / पार पाना

Success in a contest.
हिंदी: जीत

Being saved from wrongdoing.
हिंदी: मुक्ति / उद्धार / भूल-सुधार
